title: diego personal finance-legal todo
content:
Daily scratchpad / to-dos (finance & legal) — Diego Ramos

Top priorities (this week):
- [ ] Invoice reconciliation for Jan/Feb (due reconciliation meeting Fri 2026-03-05)
    - INV-2026-0012 (Acme Co) $12,345.67 — verify PO and VAT lines, ask ops for PO # if missing
    - INV-2026-0031 (Nimbus Labs) $4,200.00 — dispute: services line item mismatch with SOW (see email thread)
    - INV-2025-0998 (vendor cleanup) — partial credit pending from vendor (follow-up with procurement)
- [ ] Contract redlines to finish: RD-CL-2025-09 (Data Ingest Partnership)
    - Key asks: make indemnity mutual (legal suggested text in last email)
    - Change payment terms 45 -> 30 days (Finance prefers 30)
    - Add clause: encryption-at-rest for PII + KMS integration (ops/infra sign-off req)
    - Action: send redline to partner by 2026-03-03 and cc Legal (Lena)
- [ ] Renewal reminders / subscription checks
    - Zendesk (CC: product-tools) auto-renew 2026-04-01 — confirm usage and negotiate 10% discount (contact: Jordan)
    - Cloud-monitoring license (Datadog) renewal 2026-03-22 — check if seats reduced last quarter
    - Dedicated infra contract (Vendor: GpuCloud) renewal window opens 2026-03-15 — schedule renewal planning mtg w/Infra (Maya)

Notes / background context:
- Nimbus Labs invoice INV-2026-0031: services were delivered but description on invoice is generic. I flagged in JIRA-FIN-1123 — need a quick call with PM (Priya) to confirm deliverables before approving.
- Acme Co: missing VAT number on invoice — Ops has PO in AirTable but not mirrored to the invoice. Ask procurement to resend corrected invoice or provide vendor self-bill confirmation.

Quick redline checklist (what I usually check):
- Payment terms, late fee cap, termination for convenience, indemnity scope, IP ownership, data security obligations, audit rights, SLA credits, export/compliance language, insurance minima.
- For any redline that affects ops (security, infra), ping the relevant owner and include explicit technical acceptance criteria.

Unresolved questions / to research:
- Does the standard Redwood NDA template cover forensic access requests? (ask Legal — Lena)
- Confirm threshold for CFO approval on one-off credits > $10k vs standard AP credits.

Meeting/communication TODOs:
- [ ] Book 30m sync with Procurement (Rita) — align on outstanding vendor credits and open POs (propose Tue 2026-03-02 10am)
- [ ] Quick sync with Legal (Lena) re: indemnity language in RD-CL-2025-09 — share suggested redline by EOD 2026-03-01
- [ ] Follow-up Slack: #finance -> tag @jordan for Zendesk renewal negotiation

Inbox/short-term actions (triage):
- Approve small vendor payments (<$5k) — try to clear by EOD day-of receipt
- Forward disputed invoice details to PM + vendor rep (include invoice PDF, SOW excerpt)
- Attach any signed change orders to contract folder in Confluence (link above)

Notes to self (informal):
- If partner pushes back on mutual indemnity, escalate to Legal for alternate mitigation (cyber insurance proof + liability cap)
- Keep central tracker updated (Confluence table) with invoice status: pending/approved/paid/disputed

Reference links I use often:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/FIN/Invoices+Q1+2026
- JIRA ticket: JIRA-FIN-1123 (Nimbus invoice dispute)
- Slack channels: #finance, #legal, #procurement

Last quick log (activity):
- 2026-02-28 10:12 — emailed partner RD-CL-2025-09 redline draft to legal for initial review
- 2026-02-27 15:45 — uploaded INV-2026-0012 doc to Confluence and flagged missing VAT

End of scratchpad. Keep this doc as working notes — copy important items into Confluence tickets or PRD when finalized.
